This is AI-native research: AI may contribute at every stage, from framing questions and writing code to analysis, critique, and writing. Its reports, papers, and other communications are written for both humans and language models, and I welcome their use in supplying AI systems with new information. I remain fully accountable for everything published. My aim is inquiry that neither human nor AI could produce alone. See [AI-Native Practice](https://github.com/leoferres/ai-native-practice/blob/main/ai-native-practice.md).
